column6: Work, family and school merged into one day. No more double-booking.
column7: Behind and to the left of the phone, three translucent glassy calendar sheets fan out and flow into the phone like streams merging, each with a colored edge and a short label: "Google · Work" (blue-green), "Outlook · Family" (pink), "School ICS" (amber). A small floating card reads "0 conflicts ✓". A handwritten arrow note reads "all in one".

column6: Type “an hour with Sam next week” and TimeIQ books it.
column7: A large glossy speech bubble floats out of the phone reading "Find an hour with Sam next week", with a tangerine microphone icon and a soft audio waveform. A second card pops out lower reading "Invite sent ✓" with a tiny confetti burst. A handwritten arrow note reads "that's it".

column6: Add agent@timeiq.app to any email. It finds the time and books the meeting for you.
column7: A realistic paper envelope and an email card fly toward the phone on a dotted motion trail. The email card reads "To: Sam · Cc: agent@timeiq.app" and "Coffee this week?". Where the trail meets the phone, a glowing card reads "Booked ✓ Sam Okafor · Wed 10:00 AM" with a tangerine dot. A handwritten arrow note reads "handled".

column6: Send your open times in one tap, in any time zone.
column7: From the phone, a message bubble flies out reading "Tue 9:30 AM – 3:00 PM · Wed 9:30 AM – 3:00 PM" toward two small round world-clock faces labeled "New York" and "London" floating at the right, joined by a thin dotted arc over a faint globe. A tiny tap-ripple sits on the phone's Share availability button. A handwritten arrow note reads "sent!".

column6: Share your link. Clients pick a time and pay up front.
column7: The background's upper area turns into a calm night sky with a thin crescent moon and a few soft stars. A floating payment card reads "Paid ✓ $150.00" with "Strategy session · 60 min" below it, and a small notification card reads "New booking · 2:14 AM". A handwritten arrow note reads "2 AM payday".

column6: Email the soccer schedule to TimeIQ. Every game lands on your calendar and your time is blocked.
column7: A forwarded email envelope opens beside the phone and a realistic paper PDF page flies out of it toward the screen, titled "Riverside FC · Spring Schedule" listing exactly "Sat Nov 21 · 10:00 AM", "Sat Nov 28 · 10:00 AM" and "Sat Dec 5 · 10:00 AM". A small soccer ball rests near the bottom corner. A floating card on the phone edge reads "8 events added ✓" with a tangerine dot, and a handwritten arrow note reads "game on!".
